Phew, this was a big step for someone without any javascript/jquery/ajax experience. I finally got the hang of it today and am proud to say that it is working as I wanted it to work.

Everything is async and voting happens in the background together with reranking. DOMs are manipulated by jQuery to change the arrows to upvoted, downvoted or reset to default.

For now, voting is only implemented for submissions (self and link posts). Voting on comments (and overhaul of commenting system) is on the way.
